links.outcome: Drop in AUC from cross-validation to prospective unseen validation set
links.effect: Random forest cross-validation AUC 0.74 fell to 0.70 (95% CI .65-.75) on the unseen prospective validation set, below the prespecified 0.75 target.
links.quote: The best-fitting classifier (random forest, cross-validation AUC, 0.74) achieved an AUC of 0.70 (95% confidence interval, .65-.75).

unlisted_practices: Using a machine learning classifier to prioritize postprescription antibiotic review, compared with random selection of patients for review

screen.reason: Evaluates feasibility and predictive performance of supervised ML models to prioritize inpatients for postprescription antibiotic review using prospective validation data and simulated clinical utility.
